ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the lateral lobes and 40% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields on the left and right lobes. Central black region bifurcates at the notch. Extensive black mottling observed along the interior margins of the white lobes. A distinct, isolated black elliptical spot is located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an approximate internal angle of 125 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 4% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the superior trailing edge. Pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-12 pixels, with more pronounced jaggedness on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on the superior edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, low-intensity circular spots detected on the mid-white region of the left lobe and scattered high-intensity (white) pinpoints within the central dark region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent horizontal black linear disruption approximately 25 pixels in length on the medial-left white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive reddish-brown discoloration and irregular tissue morphology at the far right distal tip, indicative of localized trauma or parasitic attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique dark 'dash' mark located in the upper-left white lobe field, distinct from the marginal mottling.
